_comment: Per-layout blueprint specs. Each layout: source (master|proposal-example) + slide file + shape map. shape entries are keyed by cNvPr id in the source slide. kind=scalar (single line) or list (bullet array, paragraph cloned per item). group ties shapes together for pruning when the controlling slot is empty.

icon-list-split._geometry_comment: Re-flowed from the master's label-left/value-right + sidebar-callout layout into 4 full-width stacked blocks (bold label over wrapped value), spread vertically. The narrow value column + sidebar made long descriptive values overlap; full width lets the same text wrap to ~2 lines per block. Sidebar-callout need is covered by two-col-text-callout.

two-col-contrast.note: Hand-authored from three-col-cards (no source slide). Rebuild with the one-off builder, not build_blueprints.

data-table.note: Generic blue-header data/requirements/dependencies table (Tipo|Descripcion). Fill ROWS with a list of [cell, cell] rows, or {header, rows} to override the header. Net-new: existing tables (pricing-table, capacity-table) are domain-specific.

capability-grid.note: NATIVE re-extraction (was agentes). 6 numbered capability cards 3x2: card + blue badge (fixed 1-6) + TITLE + BODY. Each card a prunable group. drop=[41,42,35] logo + page-number + stray 21 literal.

benefits-icons.note: Four benefit columns: icon (picture) + ellipse + HEADER + BODY (prose). Empty BENEFITn_HEADER prunes the whole column, including its icon <p:pic> (relies on the pic-aware group pruning in fill_blueprint). Net-new: horizontal icon/stat benefits row.

pros-cons-split.note: Two-column pain-points vs opportunities. Left column = up to 5 red numbered cards (PAINn_BODY); right column = up to 5 green cards (OPPn_BODY). Empty body prunes the card. Net-new: the only layout with semantic red/green contrast. Bounded-accent exception: red (#C0392B/#FCEEEE pain) + green (#1E8E5A/#EAF7F0 opportunity) are kept on purpose; only off-palette navy is normalized. header_normalize=[2,4,5,7] drops the source number-badge/icon-circle/icon-pic and the LEAD subtitle (dense layout has no room) and restyles SECTION/TITLE to the master header pattern.

value-stats-cta.note: Three KPI stat cards (big STATn number + STATn_LABEL + STATn_DESC) over a full-width highlight panel (PANEL_TITLE + PANEL_LEFT + PANEL_RIGHT). Empty STATn prunes a card; empty PANEL_TITLE prunes the panel. Net-new: the only layout with large-number metrics. Off-palette greens normalized to master navy; panel tint to off-white; stat-3 neutral gray kept. drop=[10,16,22,28,...] removes the source decorative icon pics inside the stat/panel circles (meaningless out of context — one was the Plain Concepts logo); the colored circles stay as clean accent dots. header_normalize=[2,4,5,7] drops the source number-badge/icon-circle/icon-pic and the LEAD subtitle and restyles SECTION/TITLE to the master header pattern.

layered-architecture.note: NATIVE re-extraction (was sermes). 5 stacked horizontal layer bands (F2F3F7), each a prunable group. drop=[16,21] logo + page-number.

statement.note: Big narrative statement: SECTION label + STATEMENT (large insight) + SUPPORTING context paragraph. drop=[5,6] removes offerings top-right logo pic + page-number placeholder (master chrome grafted by normalize_chrome).

maturity-staircase.note: Ascending 5-step maturity staircase (Level 1..5, each = card + blue badge dot + tag + name) over a foundation base bar. SECTION+TITLE header, AXIS vertical label, BASE foundation bar. Each step is a prunable group (empty STEPn_NAME prunes its card+badge). Fills the previously-deferred maturity-staircase (no clean source existed). drop=[30,31] removes offerings logo pic + page-number.

quote.note: Full-bleed dark quote slide: large QUOTE + ATTRIB (author/title). Dark navy bg recolored to master 1A1A2E. drop=[10,11] page-number + offerings logo.

references.note: Appendix/references: SECTION+TITLE, SOURCES line, up to 4 numbered reference lines (each a prunable group). drop=[11,16] offerings logo + page-number.

kpi-row-4.note: Row of 4 KPI cards (big VALUE % + LABEL + DESC + SOURCE) + a full-width highlight INSIGHT bar. Each KPI is a prunable group. Insight bar (accent4 yellow) recolored to primary blue. drop=[29,30] offerings logo + page-number.

logo-wall.note: 2x3 client-logo wall: SECTION+TITLE + up to 6 logo cells (gray box placeholder + LOGOn label, prunable). Boxes stay as image placeholders. drop=[18,19].

team-photos.note: Row of 4 team members: photo placeholder box + NAME + ROLE + BIO. Each member a prunable group (empty NAME prunes it). PHOTO slot clears the [Photo] bracket; box stays as image placeholder. drop=[26,31].

data-insights.note: Left chart/graph placeholder + right column of 3 insights (TITLE+DESC each, prunable). CHART slot clears the placeholder bracket; box stays. drop=[14,19].

objectives-grid.note: Left context panel (STATEMENT + POINTS bullets + OBJ_HEADER) and a 2x2 grid of numbered objective cards (blue, 01-04). Each objective a prunable group. drop=[25,26].

matrix-2x2.note: 2x2 strategic matrix: 4 quadrant cards (TITLE+DESC) with X/Y axis labels and divider lines. Each quadrant a prunable group. drop=[4,5,42] (logo, page-number, stray 17 literal).

case-study.note: Case study: 3 columns (Challenge/Solution/Results = HEADER+DESC with blue tick) over 3 KPI cards (VALUE %+LABEL). Columns and KPIs prunable. drop=[24,29].

risk-table.note: 4 risk rows (shape-based, not a real table): blue priority badge (H/M/L) + TITLE + MITIGATION + OWNER + TIMELINE. Each row a prunable group. drop=[34,39].

next-steps.note: 4 numbered action-item rows (shape-based): fixed 1-4 badge + TITLE + DESC + OWNER + DATE. Each row a prunable group. drop=[34,39].

paradigm-shift.note: Left: LEFT_HEADER + 3 numbered step descriptions. Right: 3 change areas (HEADER + POINTS bullets). Steps and areas prunable. drop=[22,23].

dual-row.note: Two rows of 3 cards: top row blue objective cards (HEADER+DESC), bottom row navy action cards. Each card a prunable group. accent4 (yellow) recolored to navy for on-brand contrast. drop=[25,29].

before-after.note: Before/After comparison: navy BEFORE panel vs blue AFTER panel, HEADER + 4 prunable points each. accent4 (yellow before box) recolored to navy. drop=[18,23].

agenda-3panel.note: Agenda divider: left "Agenda" + blue image strip + dark right panel with HEADER and up to 4 numbered agenda items (prunable). IMAGE_STRIP clears its bracket. drop=[27,28].

milestone-timeline.note: Horizontal milestone timeline: 4 milestone cards (alternating up/down) on a baseline, each MONTH badge + TITLE + DESC. Fixed 4-milestone geometry; each a prunable group. drop=[39,40].

impact-numbers.note: Native large-number layout: left hero stat (HERO_VALUE % + HERO_LABEL + HERO_SUB + HERO_DESC) and right column of 3 metric rows (VALUE % + LABEL + DESC, prunable). drop=[26,27,20] logo + page-number + stray 26 literal.

quarterly-roadmap.note: Quarterly roadmap: 4 quarter columns (Q1-Q4), each 3 initiative cards (TITLE+DESC) with fixed status badge (In Progress/Planned/Completed) + illustrative progress bar. Each card a prunable group. Planned purple badge recolored to neutral gray. drop=[102,103].
